text.p: Conversion Technologies International Inc said on Wednesday that Harvey Goldman, its vice chairman, president and chief executive, will resign to accept another position.
Conversion said in a news release that its chairman, Eckardt Beck, will be acting president and chief executive until the company's proposed merger with Octagon Inc closes.

Conversion also said Octagon's special shareholders meeting on the merger scheduled for Thursday will be adjourned until June 16, to give the shareholders supplemental information about the termination of a government contract under which Octagon was the subcontractor.
Conversion Technologies makes industrial abrasives and recycles cathode ray tube glass.
Octagon provides radiological control and operations and maintenance services to nuclear utilities. The company also provides services to certain federal agencies.
